scope: Enemy catalog and impact/feedback authoring; templates do not invoke models or certify output.

prompts.intent: Create an independently replaceable enemy appearance
prompts.prompt: Inspect registered role {{ROLE}} in game/enemy-catalog.mjs and presentation family {{THEME}}. Preserve its collider, behavior, image-slot name, risk badge and heading convention. Create original art with the image tool if raster assets are requested; preserve source/provenance and compare compact and detailed treatments at actual play size. Bind only through supported visual overrides; test pause, freeze, warning and reduced effects. Use the enemy workshop to preview and practice. Changing a catalog enable switch affects future authoring only. Follow docs/feature-delivery-workflow.md for a completed implementation.
prompts.example_request: Render enemy-role-skin using the requested theme or registered role; inspect outputs before publication.

prompts.prompt: Use the enemy workshop to prepare a {{THEME}} roster with seven explicit registered role records. Explain each role’s location, movement, danger and cue. Save/reload and export/import the bounded catalog document; test disabled roles cannot start a study. Apply a roster only to a new draft level through the existing catalog materialization seam. Never silently remove actors from an existing campaign, save or rated run. New primitives require code and tests.
prompts.example_request: Render enemy-authoring-roster using the requested theme or registered role; inspect outputs before publication.

prompts.prompt: Create a new authored map {{MAP_ID}} using optional classic.lineImpact version line-impact.v1 and validated speed. Explain two fronts, growing trails, capture-before-arrival escape and immediate direct-body contact. Prove ordinary input outcomes for both turning modes, queued-turn save/restore, pause, multiple seeds and recovery. Reuse a prior image only with honest provenance. Preserve older campaign IDs/proofs and enforce pack/offline budgets. Do not present inferred XPOSED timing as measured fact.
prompts.example_request: Render line-impact-challenge using the requested theme or registered role; inspect outputs before publication.

prompts.intent: Refine pickup and life-loss feedback across a theme
prompts.prompt: Inspect actual {{THEME}} play, four pickup glyphs and theme-aware destruction/recovery in game/ui/event-feedback.mjs and classic-view.mjs. Keep heart, chevrons, hourglass and snowflake distinct even without color. Copy event-time coordinates; never place an old batched event at the current player position. Read effect timers and impact fronts from authoritative simulation state. Preserve bounded queues and static reduced-effects meaning, avoid flashes that obscure the route, inspect actual playback, and compare unchanged checkpoint hashes. Prompts and contact sheets are not completed animations.
prompts.example_request: Render pickup-defeat-feedback using the requested theme or registered role; inspect outputs before publication.
